finalLens.move: Write down one future use for that amount before deciding whether the comfort is worth releasing it.

mergedCandidate.move: Say thank you, name the piece you shaped, and leave the sentence there.

finalLens.title: Keeping What Works
finalLens.intro: Before abandoning the morning sequence, you notice the one repeated task that makes everything else take longer.
finalLens.pull_quote: I can change the part that wears me down and still keep what works.
finalLens.deeper_read: The same step keeps sending you back to redo what was already handled, and irritation gathers there first. A small adjustment lets your own way of doing things remain inside the repetition, without requiring you to harden against it.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for the moment you start redoing a familiar task or begin to pull away from it.
finalLens.move: Move one repeated task to a different point in the sequence for the next few days.
